meta.description: Abubuwan sauti da hoto masu inganci ga alamu, cibiyoyi da ayyukan kirkire-kirkire.

hero.sub: Muna samar da abubuwan sauti da hoto masu inganci ga alamu da cibiyoyi da ke son isar da sako da tasiri na gaskiya.

problems.p1desc: Muna ƙirƙira labarun gani da ke isar da ainihin ɗayan ku.
problems.p2title: Samarwa mai dacewa da kasafin kuɗinku
problems.p2desc: Daga talla na kamfani zuwa manyan yaƙe-yaƙe.
problems.p3desc: Gudanarwa mai sauƙi daga shirye-shiryen farko zuwa isar da ƙarshe.

services.heading: Audiovisual Services
services.sub: We cover the full production cycle — from concept to distribution.
services.s1desc: Corporate videos, brand presentations, content for social media and digital platforms.
services.s1f3: Abun ciki na kafofin watsa labarun
services.s2desc: Short films and fiction projects aimed at national and international festivals.
services.s3desc: Corporate, product, event and portrait photography. Images that communicate before you read a single word.
services.s4desc: Video editing, color grading, motion graphics, sound mixing and VFX.
services.s5desc: Aikin kyamara, zanen haske, fasaha na LED/videowall da gudanar da mataki don bukukuwa, kiɗa, wasan kwaikwayo da taron kamfanoni.
services.s6desc: Colombia–Spain–India connection. Projects with global reach through co-production agreements.

portfolio.heading: Portfolio
portfolio.cajamarDesc: Audiovisual content production for CAJAMAR, one of Spain's ten most significant financial cooperative groups.
portfolio.selfieDesc: Fina-finai gajere na almara. Juan Ospina a matsayin mataimaki/mai shirya fina-finai. An nuna shi a bukukuwan ƙasashe da dama.
portfolio.vilesDesc: Horror short film. Dir. Dave Alcaide. 6 international awards in 2024.
portfolio.sportsDesc: Aikin kyamara don RFEF Copa del Rey, Copa LEB ORO (ƙwallon kwando), Wasannin Tseren Mutane na Spain, MotorSport TV, Melilla TV da Cabal Esports.

awards.heading: Kyautuka na Duniya
awards.sub: Fim gajere Viles (2023), wanda Juan Ospina ya shiga a matsayin mataimaki na kyamara na farko, an amince da shi a bukukuwa 6 na fina-finai a Indiya, UK, Faransa da Amurka a duk 2024.

about.heading: Fasaha ba tare da shingaye na bayyanawa ba
about.lead: Masala Studios an haife shi da hangen nesa na utopia: don ƙirƙirar fasaha ba tare da iyakokin kirkira ko na yanki ba. Sunan yana cewa komai — masala, a cikin Hindi, yana nufin 'cakuda kayan yaji'.
about.body: Muna gaskata cewa bayan tasiri ga waɗanda ke ganin aikin a yau, yana yiwuwa a ƙirƙiri hoton gaskiya mai aminci da za a iya dawo da shi a nan gaba don karatun tarihi, kamar gano kayan tarihi.

about.exp1desc: Zanen haske don wasan kwaikwayo na jiki da al'ada game da sakamakon rayuwa bayan annobar. Yan wasa huɗu a tafiya ta yanayi tare da hotunan jiki masu haɗari da kuma karin murya kusa da na ibada, inda haske yake wani ɓangare na labari.
about.exp2desc: Wasan kwaikwayo na kiɗa game da shekaru 40 na tarihin kiɗan Spain. Alhakin duk kayan kida da kuma kula da su a duk rangadin cikakke: Madrid, Seville, Valencia da Barcelona.
about.exp3desc: Sanya, gwaji da kuma amfani da tsarin allon LED kai tsaye don wasan kiɗa da aka sayar. Haɗa hotuna tare da haske na mataki da kuma jeri abubuwan yanayi na ainihi.
about.exp4desc: Ginin mataki don Starlite Occident Music Festival a Auditorio de Marbella. Ginin mataki, shigar fasaha da kuma kula da ababen hawa na samarwa.
about.exp5desc: Mai aikin kyamara don wakilin TV na ƙasa yayin Operation Santiago-Rusadir, 2024.
about.exp6desc: Sanya, aiki da kulawa da fasahar LED don nune-nunen jigon Pixar a IFEMA Madrid. Tsarin Videowall tare da Novastar, tallafin kaya a duk ɗakunan jigo (Inside Out, Up, da sauransu).
about.exp7desc: Mai aikin kyamara na livestream don wasannin RFEF Copa del Rey 2023-2024 ta fasahar LiveU. Har ila yau: ƙwallon kwando na Copa LEB ORO (ATM Broadcast), Gasar Tseren Mutane ta Spain (Quality Media).
about.exp8desc: Festival Cala de Mijas, Big Andalusia by Mad Cool, Reggaeton Beach Festival (Marbella), Fruit Attraction (IFEMA), ESMO Congress, SEEN-ABBOTT. Fasahan LED wall, videowall, sauti da haske a manyan wurare.
about.exp9desc: Mai aikin kyamara don livestream na Twitch na gasar ƙasa ta Tom Clancy's Rainbow Six Siege ta Ubisoft a gasar wasan bidiyo na Gamepolis.
about.exp10desc: Aikin koyon sanya da kuma post-production na sauti-hoto don fim na gaskiya game da Barcelona bayan mulkin kama-karya a shekarun 1970. Har ila yau: aikin koyon gyara bidiyo a Europa FM (Atresmedia Radio).
